chapters.title: Recursive
chapters.code:
def reverse_list(head):
    if head is None or head.next is None:
        return head
    new_head = reverse_list(head.next)
    head.next.next = head                  # the old next now points back
    head.next = None
    return new_head

chapters.title: Iterative with three pointers
chapters.code:
def reverse_list(head):
    prev, cur = None, head
    while cur:
        nxt = cur.next                     # save before overwriting
        cur.next = prev
        prev, cur = cur, nxt
    return prev
